title: "Person. Woman. Man. Camera. TV."
commentary: The bar was on the floor. He still had to duck to clear it.
Five nouns, no sentence, presented as proof of genius.
Somewhere a neurologist is quietly screaming into a pillow.
It's a screening test. He wore it like a gold medal.

title: The disinfectant briefing
commentary: Turns out 'doing your own research' has a floor, too.
Dr. Birx's face said everything the transcript can't.
Somewhere, a bottle of Lysol filed a restraining order.
"It sounds interesting to me" is doing a lot of work in that sentence.

title: "Very fine people on both sides"
commentary: A press conference that started about infrastructure and ended up defining a presidency.
The follow-up nobody wanted him to answer again. He answered again.
Some quotes age like milk. This one aged like milk left in the sun.

title: The solar eclipse, no glasses
commentary: An aide yelled 'Don't look!' The response was to look.
NASA spent decades building eclipse-safety awareness. This undid a chunk of it in four seconds.
The most expensive sunglasses budget in the country, and he waited.
